bullets: Gemini 3.8 Flash (and MiMo 2.6 Pro) now show in CLI and Desktop pickers but are locked for accounts without a paid plan.
Feedback can now be submitted with a thumbs up or down and no text, using the new rating field.
A runaway model is now capped at 8 follow-up-suggestion tool calls per response and the step request cancels only that step.
Repeated unchanged to-do lists now short-circuit as a no-op instead of being rewarded as a fresh success.
Advertisers can now set a placement daily cap as low as $25, raised from the previous $5 minimum.
X now uses a 90-day click attribution window for paid social, while TikTok stays on 7 days.
Ads acquisition now tracks a separate Meta pixel ID and supports CompleteRegistration, CampaignSubmitted, and AddPaymentInfo events.
An advertiser signup offer grants a one-time $500 promotional credit when spending $500 within 30 days of account creation.
Paid chat completions now produce one telemetry row in the operator log, carrying only identifiers and never the prompt, completion, or secret.
